product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-native, AI-powered medical-imaging operating system that unifies PACS, radiology workflows, image viewing and reporting for imaging centers and radiologists.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer; the pricing URL yielded no page, and the demo page contains a contact form rather than plans.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage's health-system logo wall.

founded_year.notes: Listed on the company's LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows clinical education, PACS selection/security and operational-efficiency content, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Eden.

public_docs.notes: Public REST API documentation includes multiple articles covering orders, studies, appointments and quotations.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model is marked active and has an application link.

model_provider.notes: Eden describes Cortex as a foundation model that generates complete radiology reports from medical images.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly displayed claims and badges; no SOC 2 report type or independent audit verification is implied.

last_funding.notes: Latest identified round, reported October 10, 2025, led by Sierra Ventures.

raised_18mo.notes: The $22 million Series A reported in October 2025 falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable Y Combinator jobs board lists one AI-research role and no SDR, BDR or account-executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Eden introduced Cortex, its medical-image interpretation and radiology-reporting foundation model, in an October 14, 2026 company post.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: March 2, 2026 coverage reports Eden's hiring of radiologist Felipe Kitamura as Chief Medical Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable public API documentation names no CRM or sales/marketing systems.
